source_text.ISS-0930:
id: ISS-0930
title: "D1 BLOCKER: seeded meridian/vortex service-task endpoints fail with request_build_error; instances ERROR at first service task"
discovered_by: UAT-RUNNER
discovered_in_run: ISS-0912 QA re-run 2026-10-01 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
severity: BLOCKER
description: >
  Every seeded service-task endpoint (POST /kyc/screen, /mes/.../quarantine, /mes/.../assign) fails request_build_error on QA; instances go to ERROR at kyc-aml-check / assign-line / quarantine-batch, so no meridian or vortex scenario can complete.
  Source: test/uat-reports/uat-2026-10-01-ISS0912-NARRATIVE.yaml.
source_reports:
  - test/uat-reports/uat-2026-10-01-ISS0912-NARRATIVE.yaml
related:
  - ISS-0912
queue_ref: Q-913  # queue issue_ref ISS-0913 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0930
github_ref: GH-2064
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 3d REVIEWER gate for ISS-0930. Review git diff origin/main..HEAD (non-handoff files) in context.worktree against the validated design lib/letflow/design/iss0930-seed-service-task-endpoints.md: scope creep (only fixtures/seed scripts/helper/README; engine, url_validator, simulation YAML untouched), consistency with decision records in docs/migration/decisions/ (esp. any on service tasks / SSRF / connector catalog / seeding ISS-0897 design), idiomatic shell correctness (set -euo pipefail interplay with the new helper, sourcing path robustness when run from any cwd, jq usage), behaviour vs design section 5 version rules, fixture JSON sanity (25 nodes, 1.1 versions, no leftover relative endpoints or single-brace placeholders: verify with jq yourself), and whether bumping fixture version to 1.1 conflicts with any other consumer of these fixtures (grep test/, scripts/, docs/ for '1.0' assumptions, e.g. UAT scenarios keyed by version, definition_name lookups). Also list the MINOR from SECURITY-REVIEWER (step-03c): README should state httpbin.org receives rendered path IDs and QA data must be synthetic - say whether it is required now (if so FAIL with that single item, or PASS with it as a mandatory DOC follow-up: ORCH will have it applied before merge - choose PASS with follow-up unless something else blocks). Modify nothing but this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to TEST-DESIGNER' on PASS.
acceptance_criteria: Shell and fixture correctness independently verified
Other consumers of fixture version checked

result.summary: Diff matches the validated design. No scope creep: only 5 QA fixtures, 3 seed scripts, 1 new sourced helper, scripts/README.md and the design doc changed; zero changes under lib/ except the design doc (engine, UrlValidator, simulation YAML, uat fixtures untouched). No decision record covers service-task seed endpoints; 0022/0027/0029/0030 only mention the SSRF gate (INV-9) which is left intact, so no conflict. No anti-patterns hit. The regression test qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints_test.exs is not in the diff yet (belongs to TEST-DESIGNER next).

checks.decision_records: PASS - none contradicted; OQ-2 (leave simulation YAML relative) agreed, it is not the generation source
checks.shell: PASS - bash -n clean on all scripts; helper sourced via SCRIPT_DIR (cwd-independent); jq uses --arg; version_is_older is only called in if/elif so set -e/pipefail is safe. Functionally run: sort -V ordering 1.0<1.1, 1.9<1.10, 1.1==1.1 and 1.2 vs 1.1 and 1.10 vs 1.9 not older (correct); rewrite with custom base rewrote all 3 swiftroute endpoints and changed only those 6 diff lines; http://, whitespace, bare https:// all exit 1 with ERROR; trailing slash stripped; empty env falls back to default. Matches design section 5 (skip equal / replace older / warn+skip newer, exit 0).
checks.fixtures: PASS - verified with jq: all 5 at version 1.1, names unchanged; SERVICE_TASK counts 7+6+3+6+3=25; all endpoints start https://httpbin.org/anything/, all have method POST, no single-brace placeholders, no leftover POST /path or relative endpoints; node counts 22/16/9/10/13 (only the 25 service-task nodes touched per diffstat).
checks.other_consumers: PASS - no consumer keyed on definition version 1.0. UAT scenario version: 1.0 is the scenario version; alias sidecars map by definition_name (unchanged); uat_preflight.sh compares names; seed_swiftroute_definition_test.exs compares node/edge ids, escalation attrs and a CEL condition, not endpoints or version; req206/207/208 simulation tests build their own in-test 1.0 definitions. Only historical report text mentions QA v1.0 (intended to be superseded).

findings: MINOR cosmetic: for SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL=https:// the error message prints got: https:/ (post-strip value). Harmless.

MINOR (design-accepted): rewrite_service_task_base silently no-ops on nodes whose endpoint does not start with the default base; acceptable since the test asserts all endpoints carry the default prefix.
type-safety: none found (no new transition logic); no docs/issues entry filed.
result.mandatory_doc_followup: SECURITY-REVIEWER MINOR is NOT blocking, so PASS with follow-up: scripts/README.md (section QA seed scripts) does not yet state that httpbin.org receives the rendered path IDs (application_id, review_id, order_id, batch_ref, deviation_id, shipment_id) plus source IP, that QA data for seeded processes must be synthetic/non-PII, that SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL should point at a self-hosted echo for any QA env holding non-synthetic data, and that production must never be seeded with these fixtures. ORCH must have this applied before merge.
